name: stage-sql-best-effort-copy
body: stage_sql mirrors stage_csharp: it treats the dotnet publish as the success test (exit status ok and the published sqlfrontend exists) and copies the binary into the frontends stage dir best-effort (`let _ = std::fs::copy`), so a failed copy still returns `sql` into APG_LANGUAGES while APG_FRONTEND_SQL points at the published path under OUT_DIR/sql-dist. Upgrade to a fail-closed copy (drop `sql` from the returned list when the copy fails) if staged-dir presence must ever be verified at build time.
